title: fix(pi): do not pass --no-session so chained prompts can --fork the session

files.patch:
@@ -339,11 +339,7 @@ def command_line
               command.push("--model", @model) if @model
               command.push("--system-prompt", @replace_system_prompt) if @replace_system_prompt
               command.push("--append-system-prompt", @append_system_prompt) if @append_system_prompt
-              if @session.present?
-                command.push("--fork", @session)
-              else
-                command.push("--no-session")
-              end
+              command.push("--fork", @session) if @session.present?
               command
             end
           end

@@ -665,7 +665,6 @@ class RoastExamplesTest < FunctionalTest
             "anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
             "--append-system-prompt",
             "Always respond in haiku form",
-            "--no-session",
           ],
           expected_stdin_content: "What is the world's largest lake?",
         })

@@ -168,7 +168,7 @@ def failure_status
           assert_includes command, "--mode"
           assert_includes command, "json"
           assert_includes command, "-p"
-          assert_includes command, "--no-session"
+          refute_includes command, "--no-session"
         end
 
         test "command_line uses custom command when configured as string" do
@@ -229,11 +229,11 @@ def failure_status
           refute_includes command, "--no-session"
         end
 
-        test "command_line includes --no-session when no session is set" do
+        test "command_line does not pass --no-session or --fork when no session is set" do
           invocation = Pi::PiInvocation.new(@config, "Test prompt", nil)
 
           command = invocation.send(:command_line)
-          assert_includes command, "--no-session"
+          refute_includes command, "--no-session"
           refute_includes command, "--fork"
         end

@@ -139,18 +139,23 @@ def mock_status(success:)
           input.prompts = ["Main task", "Finalizer"]
 
           fork_flags = []
+          no_session_flags = []
           CommandRunner.stubs(:execute).with do |args, **kwargs|
             fork_flags << args.include?("--fork")
+            no_session_flags << args.include?("--no-session")
             session_json = { type: "session", id: "session_1" }.to_json
             kwargs[:stdout_handler]&.call(session_json)
             true
           end.returns(["", "", mock_status(success: true)])
 
           @provider.invoke(input)
 
-          # First invocation has no session, so --no-session (no --fork).
+          # First invocation has no session to fork from. It must not pass
+          # --no-session, otherwise Pi keeps the session in memory only and the
+          # second invocation cannot --fork from it.
           # Second invocation forks from the first session.
           assert_equal [false, true], fork_flags
+          assert_equal [false, false], no_session_flags
         end
 
         test "invoke uses --fork for first invocation when input has session" do
